user.title: Register a child
user.description:
Register one child. Add another integration entry for additional children.

⚠️ This information is for reference only and does not replace medical consultation.

init.title: Edit child
init.description: Edit name, birthdate, or sex. Stored measurements and completion marks are kept; schedules and percentiles are recalculated.

record_measurement.name: Record measurement
record_measurement.description: Store height/weight/head circumference and refresh percentiles.

delete_measurement.name: Delete measurement
delete_measurement.description: Delete a whole record for a date, or only some of its fields.

get_measurements.name: Get measurements
get_measurements.description: Return stored measurement records in date order.

mark_event_done.name: Mark event done
mark_event_done.description: Mark vaccine doses, infant checkups, or oral checkups as done.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Return every vaccine/checkup/oral-checkup window with event_id and status.
